## Release Note Guide

Use `Customer Release Note` to tell the user-visible story in 1-3 short
paragraphs. Cover the outcome, not just the implementation. For larger PRs,
mention the major customer-facing areas touched, such as dashboard, tasks,
equipment, documents, reports, Android, or public pages.

Example:

Maintley now gives homeowners a clearer way to understand what needs attention,
what has already been maintained, and how their home records are improving over
time.

This release improves task and equipment views, adds richer Maintenance
Profiles, expands public discovery pages, and makes Maintley Intelligence more
useful when maintenance history suggests a recurring reminder may be out of
date.
